reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Hiroshima AI Process and trustworthy AI rules
themes.definition: The speaker promotes international governance of AI, especially its own Hiroshima AI Process principles and code of conduct for safe, secure and trustworthy (generative) AI.
themes.inclusion: Include references to international AI principles, codes of conduct, or governance initiatives such as the Hiroshima AI Process.
themes.exclusion: Exclude purely domestic digital policy without international rule-making.
themes.boundary_cases: Commitment to contribute to AI discussions at the UN also qualifies for AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: Japan took the initiative to launch the Hiroshima AI Process, establishing the world's first international world's first international principles and code of conduct to govern generative AI.
there is an urgent need to establish international governance on artificial intelligence (AI) in order to maximize the opportunities brought by AI while mitigating its risks

themes.label: Safety cooperation on frontier AI
themes.definition: Cooperation on AI safety to respond to risks of highly capable frontier AI, including hosting AI summits for this purpose.
themes.inclusion: Include references to frontier AI risks, AI safety cooperation, or safety institutes/summits.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic 'safe, secure and trustworthy' slogans without a frontier/safety-risk element (AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: 'Safe, secure and trustworthy AI ecosystem' combined with frontier-risk cooperation is coded here.

examples.quote: will enhance cooperation on safety to respond to the risks of highly capable frontier AI

themes.label: AI's tremendous opportunities and challenges
themes.definition: AI framed as bringing tremendous opportunities alongside risks, including national security challenges.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit statements pairing AI benefits with AI risks or challenges.
themes.boundary_cases: If the national-security challenge is elaborated as military use, also code AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS.

examples.quote: While advances in AI bring tremendous opportunities for humanity, they also pose challenges, including those related to national security.

themes.label: Digitalization balanced with human dignity
themes.definition: Balancing digitalization and AI with human dignity, privacy and human rights through compatible international rules.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI or digital rules to privacy, human rights, or dignity.
themes.exclusion: Exclude digitalization support to developing countries without rights framing.
themes.boundary_cases: Generic digitalization risks count only when AI is referenced in the same argument, as here via the Hiroshima AI Process.

examples.quote: there are risks of privacy and human rights violations. We need a digital ecosystem and international rules that are compatible with human dignity.

themes.label: Tackling non-factual information and propaganda
themes.definition: Urgent measures against the spread of information not based on facts and propaganda, raised in the context of AI and technological innovation.
themes.inclusion: Include mentions of disinformation or propaganda raised alongside AI challenges.
themes.exclusion: Exclude disinformation discussions with no technology context.
themes.boundary_cases: When disinformation is mentioned adjacent to AI but not explicitly caused by AI, code with lower confidence.

examples.quote: We also urgently need measures to tackle the spread of information not based on facts, as well as the spread of propaganda.

themes.label: Contributing to UN AI discussions
themes.definition: Commitment to contribute to AI discussions at the United Nations.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit commitments to UN AI deliberations or processes.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general UN reform discussion without AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls for the UN to build 'new rules' generally, adjacent to AI, are borderline.

examples.quote: We will continue to actively contribute to the discussions on AI at the United Nations.

value.rationale: Japan's passages consistently promote the Hiroshima AI Process and trustworthy AI governance, framing AI as opportunity plus risk. Later speeches add frontier-AI safety cooperation and disinformation; the 2023 speech emphasises privacy and human dignity.
